name: deepseek-harness-desktop
description: Electron desktop application packaging the DeepSeek Harness Web kernel

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web-kernel && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-electron run build
scripts.pack:electron: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-electron run pack
scripts.dist:electron: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-electron run dist
scripts.dist:electron:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-electron run dist:mac
scripts.dist:electron:win: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-electron run dist:win
scripts.dist:electron:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-electron run dist:linux
